G'oya

Bo'sh katakning to'rt ko'rinishini bittaga keltiramiz: COALESCE(TRIM(q), '') NULL ni ham, probellarni ham bo'sh satrga aylantiradi. Shundan keyin katak javob emas, agar u '' yoki '-' bo'lsa. Har savol uchun CASE 0 yoki 1 beradi, beshtasini qo'shamiz.

Yechim

SELECT id, answered
FROM (
  SELECT id,
         CASE WHEN COALESCE(TRIM(q1), '') IN ('', '-') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
       + CASE WHEN COALESCE(TRIM(q2), '') IN ('', '-') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
       + CASE WHEN COALESCE(TRIM(q3), '') IN ('', '-') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
       + CASE WHEN COALESCE(TRIM(q4), '') IN ('', '-') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
       + CASE WHEN COALESCE(TRIM(q5), '') IN ('', '-') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS answered
  FROM surveys
) t
WHERE answered < 3

Hosila jadval kerak, chunki answered ni WHERE da ishlatish uchun u avval hisoblanib olinishi kerak. PostgreSQL SELECT dagi nomni shu so'rovning WHERE ida tanimaydi.

Tuzoqlar

COALESCE siz TRIM(NULL) IN ('', '-') NULL beradi va CASE ELSE 1 ga o'tib ketadi: bo'sh katak javob bo'lib qoladi.

Chiziqchani LIKE '%-%' bilan qidirish ham xato. IT-park va 2-kurs haqiqiy javoblar, ular ham bo'sh bo'lib qoladi. Bo'sh katak chiziqchaning o'zi, TRIM dan keyin aynan '-'.
